description: Hand-written overlay for the 835 payment flows. Build-CodeGraph.ps1 merges this file into the generated graph. Keep every id equal to a generated id. The build writes a placeholder node and a warning for an id that does not exist.

nodes.name: BBVA / Navigant lockbox SFTP (RevenueMed host)
nodes.detail: Sends patient lockbox 835 files and insurance lockbox 835 files. One folder for each practice region. X12 sender ZZ:BBVANAV, receiver ZZ:SMILE DOCTORS. Settings BBVA_SFTP_HOST, BBVA_835_PATIENT_FTP_FOLDER, BBVA_835_INSURANCE_FTP_FOLDER.

nodes.name: Smile Doctors web payment SFTP (OpenEdge / XWeb card and ACH payments)
nodes.detail: Sends 835-shaped files for web credit card, ACH and ACH-return payments. One folder SD-<REGION> for each practice. X12 sender ZZ:SMILE DOCTORS, receiver ZZ:CLOUD9. Settings SD_SFTP_HOST, SD_835_WEB_FTP_FOLDER.

nodes.name: Change Healthcare (Emdeon) claim submission API mailbox
nodes.detail: HTTP XML API (claim_submission_api). GetMailFileList, GetMailFile, DeleteMailFile. URL and credentials come from BTS.GetPracticeEDISettings in each practice database (pracEmdeonURL / pracEmdeonTestURL / pracEmdeonIsTest). Payload is base64 and can be PKZIP.

nodes.name: Change Healthcare SFTP (835 and 835-to-BBVA folders)
nodes.detail: SFTP receive locations exist in the bindings but are inside the DEV_ENV_START/STOP block and are disabled by default. Settings CH_SFTP_HOST, CH_SFTP_PORT, CH_835_FTP_FOLDER, CH_835_TO_BBVA_FTP_FOLDER.

nodes.name: BBVA patient lockbox 835 -> patient payment transactions
Smile Doctors web payment 835 -> patient payment transactions (card / ACH / ACH return)
BBVA insurance lockbox 835 -> insurance payment and PLB adjustment transactions
Change Healthcare ERA 835 -> insurance payment transactions or reversal to-do items
Change Healthcare 835 pass-through to the BBVA/SD SFTP (no posting)
Receive file from region folder
nodes.logic: FILE (or SFTP) receive location for each region: ${BBVA_835_PATIENT_FILE_FOLDER}\<REGION>\*.*. Archive component copies the raw file to <REGION>\Archive. EDI disassembler splits the interchange into one message for each ST transaction set and resolves the BBVA schema through party agreement BBVA_To_SmileDoctors.

nodes.name: Find practice database from folder name
nodes.logic: Practice name = name of the parent folder of the receive location (text between the last two path separators of BTS.InboundTransportLocation). Call BTS.GetPracticeConfigurationByName(@pcName) in BizTalkCloud9Common. Use pcInstanceAddress (a WCF-SQL mssql:// URI) as the practice database address. No check exists for a missing row.

nodes.name: Map 835 to ClaimPaymentBatch (one ClaimPayment for each CLP loop)
nodes.logic: See map summary. Key rules: patGUID source is NM1*QC NM109. ppGUID source is NM1*IL NM109. PaymentIdentifier = REF02 where REF01='F8'. TransactionNote = 'Deposit Date: <DTM02>, Check Date: <BPR16>, Lockbox: <REF*LB with check date and trailing underscore removed>'. Posted dates use the current date and time.

nodes.name: Post each ClaimPayment with BTS.Post835PatientTransaction
nodes.logic: For each ClaimPayment: map to Post835PatientTransaction, set lbcLockboxCodeType='PATIENT', call the proc in the practice DB. transAmount = CLP04 * -1. transStatus='N'. transGUID = new GUID. lbcLockboxCode = BPR04. Proc returns ErrorCount and ResponseMessage.

nodes.name: Write one ImportLog row for each payment
nodes.logic: BTS.AddImportLog in the practice DB. ilProcess='Process_BBVA_835Patient'. ilLogLevel 2/'Finished' if ErrorCount='0', else 0/'Failed'. ilImportGUID = BizTalk MessageID. ilExternalReference = PaymentIdentifier. ilMessage = ResponseMessage. An exception stops the loop and writes only to the Windows event log.

nodes.name: Receive file from SD-<REGION> folder
nodes.logic: ${SD_835_WEB_FILE_FOLDER}\SD-<REGION>\*.*. Same pipeline as BBVA. Agreement SmileDoctors_To_Cloud9 resolves the SmileDoctors schema namespace.

nodes.name: Map SD 835 to ClaimPaymentBatch
nodes.logic: BPR04 drives payment type: CCC (card), ACH, REV (ACH return). REF qualifiers in the CLP loop: 2H transaction ID, 1Z approval code (CCC) or check number (ACH/REV), TN masked card (CCC) or masked bank account (ACH/REV), 8X card type, EY masked routing, EM OpenEdge XWeb GUID, TD reversal. NM1*QC NM109 = patGUID, NM1*IL NM109 = ppGUID.

nodes.name: Find practice database from folder name
nodes.logic: Same as BBVA, but the folder name keeps the 'SD-' prefix. PracticeConfig.pcName must equal the folder name (for example 'SD-GULFCOAST').

nodes.name: Post each payment with BTS.Post835PatientTransaction (WEB)
nodes.logic: lbcLockboxCodeType='WEB'. transNote and transReceiptNote come from FormatNote(): ACH -> '<M/dd/yyyy> payment; Transaction ID = <id>; Response = Check Submitted'. REV -> '<M/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss tt> - Web ACH Return - ($<abs amount>) Additional Info: <id>'. CCC -> 'Approval Code=<code>; Transaction ID=<id>'. transReference = masked bank account if a routing number exists, else masked card number.

nodes.name: Write ImportLog row (no external reference)
nodes.logic: Same as BBVA patient, ilProcess='Process_SD_835Patient'. ilExternalReference is not sent. Success message is the constant 'Processed successfully'.

nodes.name: Receive file from insurance region folder
nodes.logic: ${BBVA_835_INSURANCE_FILE_FOLDER}\<REGION>\*.*. Same pipeline and agreement as the patient flow. Receive port RP_BBVA835_Insurance decides that the file is insurance (both orchestrations use the same message type).

nodes.name: Guard: CLP and PLB counts
nodes.logic: CLPCount = count of 2000 (LX) loops. PLBCount = count of PLB segments. Continue only if (CLPCount == 1) or (PLBCount == 0). Else write one failed ImportLog: 'There were {CLP} CLP payments and {PLB} PLB adjustments on transaction {ST02}' and post nothing.

nodes.name: Post each CLP with BTS.Post835InsuranceTransaction
nodes.logic: Map BBVA_835Insurance_To_ClaimPaymentBatchCanonical then ClaimPaymentCanonical_To_Post835InsuranceTransaction. patGUID = REF*EJ, pipGUID = REF*69, pipPolicyNumber = NM1*QC NM109, adaClaimNumber = CLP01, ptPaymentTypeCode = BPR04, ClaimIdentifier = TRN04, amount = CLP04 * -1. If BPR04='NON' the note also lists claim and service CAS adjustments (max 250 chars).

nodes.name: Post each PLB as an adjustment
nodes.logic: Map BBVA_835_To_AdjustmentClaimPaymentBatchCanonical: one ClaimPayment for each PLB. Amount = PLB04 * -1. AdjustmentType = PLB03-1 (C04201). ReferenceIdentifier = 'ADJ<n>-<TRN02>'. ImportLog message is prefixed 'ADJ - '.

nodes.name: Write ImportLog rows
nodes.logic: ilProcess='Process_BBVA_835Insurance'. One row for each claim and each PLB. Unhandled exception: event log then suspend the instance (resumable in BizTalk).

nodes.name: Scheduled poll of the Change Healthcare mailbox for each practice
nodes.logic: WCF-SQL polling receive location RP_CHCInboundToProcess runs EXEC BTS.QueueProcessParameters 'ProcessCHCInboundFiles' when BTS.ProcessParameter has a row with that name and ppStatus=0. Controller loops over every PracticeConfig row and calls the worker.

nodes.name: Download, decode and delete mailbox files
nodes.logic: Worker: GetPracticeEDISettings (practice DB) -> GetMailFileList -> for each file GetMailFile -> DecodePayload (base64, optional PKZIP, UTF-8) -> write to ${ADDR_FILE_ROOT}\CHC_Inbound\<pcName>_<new GUID>.edi -> DeleteMailFile. All file types (835, 277, 277CA) land in the same folder.

nodes.name: Receive CHC_Inbound file and route 835 by message type
nodes.logic: RL_CHC_Inbound_EDI with ReceiveEDIPipeline. Agreement ChangeHealthcare_Cloud9 resolves the CHC namespace. Activation filter BTS.MessageType == 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/BizTalk/EDI/X12/2006/CHC#X12_00501_835'.

nodes.name: Find practice from the file name prefix
nodes.logic: Practice name = FILE.ReceivedFileName after the last backslash, up to the first underscore. GetPracticeConfigurationByName. If pcInstanceAddress is empty, each claim logs 'Connection String not found for Claim {0} in File {1}' to BTS.Log through Common.AddLog.

nodes.name: For each CLP: reversal to-do or insurance post
nodes.logic: ReversalFlag = (CLP04 < 0) OR (CLP02 = '22') OR (any service CAS01 contains 'CR'). Reversal -> BTS.AddTodoItem(adaclaimNumber, message 'Payment for claim<n> needs reversal for amount $<CLP04>.'). Else -> BTS.Post835InsuranceTransaction. adaClaimNumber = int(CLP01.Substring(12)) (C9 claim numbers: 2-char PMS ID + 10-char Emdeon user + claim number).

nodes.name: ImportLog for each claim, BTS.Log for errors
nodes.logic: AddImportLog with ilProcess='Process_CHC_835Insurance' when a connection exists. Exceptions inside a claim go to BTS.Log (CreateLogEntry) and the loop continues with the next claim.

nodes.name: Receive CHC 835 from CHC835ToBBVA folder
nodes.logic: ${CH_835_TO_BBVA_FILE_FOLDER}\*.*, ReceiveEDIPipeline.

nodes.name: Look up outbound agreement by payee ID
nodes.logic: PayeeIdentifier = N1*PE N104. BTS.GetApplicationLookupValues(alvApplication='CHC835ToBBVA', alvLookup=<payee id>). Keys AgreementNameForSend, SenderPartyNameForSend, ReceiverPartyNameForSend. Seed row: payee 1000000004 -> ChangeHealthcare_BBVA, ChangeHealthcare, BBVA.

nodes.name: Re-serialize as X12 and send by SFTP
nodes.logic: If all three values exist, set EDI.*ForSend context properties and send through EdiSend pipeline to sftp://${SD_SFTP_HOST_BBVA}/${SD_SFTP_FOLDER_BBVA}/835/835_<MessageID>.edi. Else the message is dropped without a log. Orchestration state is Unenlisted in the Cloud9.EDI binding (Started in the PDS binding).

nodes.name: Practice database resolution
nodes.logic: BBVA and SD flows: folder name. CHC flow: file name prefix written by the mailbox worker. In every case the lookup key is BTS.PracticeConfig.pcName and the target is pcInstanceAddress.

nodes.name: Payments are posted as negative amounts
nodes.logic: Every Post835 map sets transAmount, transDueNowAmount and transTotalDueAmount to the 835 amount multiplied by -1. transProductionAmount and transClaimAmount are '0'. transIsGroup is '0'. transStatus is 'N'.

nodes.name: No transaction across a file
nodes.logic: Each payment is a separate proc call with useAmbientTransaction=false and EnableTransaction=false. A failure in payment n does not roll back payments 1..n-1. BizTalk retry is disabled (RetryCount=0). Duplicate protection, if any, is inside the practice DB procs (not in this repo).
